description: Products on the merchant's Shopify store. action list (status, title, vendor, tag, sku, query, cursor), get (id: variants, options, images), create (title, description, vendor, productType, tags, handle, seoTitle, seoDescription, status draft (default) | active, options [{name, values}], variants [{price, compareAtPrice, sku, options [{name, value}]}] or price + sku for a single one, images [{url, alt}], addToCollections), update (those fields; removeFromCollections), duplicate (id, newTitle, includeImages), set_status (id or ids, status active | draft | archived), delete (id or ids), tags (ids, addTags, removeTags), add_variants / update_variants (variants; update needs each id, e.g. new prices) / delete_variants (variantIds), add_options (options; createVariants) / delete_options (names), add_images (images) / remove_images / reorder_images (imageIds in the new order, first = main image), publish / unpublish (Online Store, or publicationId), channels (the sales channels), store (the shop's own settings: currency, plan, domain, time zone, units). Deleting, taking a live product off sale or putting one on sale, changing a live price, and removing variants, options or images answer a preview until confirm:true. Free.

action.description: default list (get when id is passed)

createVariants.description: add_options: a variant for every combination

ids.description: set_status / delete / tags: several products (up to 50)

publicationId.description: publish / unpublish: a channel from action channels (default the Online Store)

tags.description: create / update: the whole tag list

options.description: one value per option, e.g. [{ name: "Size", value: "M" }]

name: manage_shopify_products
title: Shopify products
